name: marquee
title: Marquee
description: strip: Infinite marquee with inert duplicate, hover/focus pause, and pause button (dom, server-safe, reduced motion -> static, mobile -> animates)

item.name: marquee
item.summary: strip: Infinite marquee with inert duplicate, hover/focus pause, and pause button (dom, server-safe, reduced motion -> static, mobile -> animates)

useWhen: Logo clouds, customer testimonials, and partner strips
Continuous market tickers, tech badges, and announcement banners
Visual social proof ribbons requiring smooth continuous transit
avoidWhen: Critical action buttons or primary call-to-action links that users must click immediately
Dense paragraphs of essential reading material
Pages where multiple moving strips compete for visual attention

alternatives.name: scroll-reveal
alternatives.when: When cards or media should reveal progressively upon scrolling rather than auto-looping

tiers.0: Animation paused and no duplicate copy rendered; the track is a static row, not animated (server render, prefers-reduced-motion, Save-Data, or no WebGL2)
tiers.1: CSS marquee animation; same behaviour as tiers 2 and 3 (speed does not vary by tier)
tiers.2: CSS marquee animation with hover/focus pause, width-based duration calibration and the pause button

reducedMotion.description: The animation does not run: the track is rendered static (not animated), with no duplicate copy and no pause button.

input.pointer: Hovering over the marquee pauses the animation when pauseOnHover is true
input.touch: No touch-specific behaviour; the animation runs on touch devices unless reduced motion is set
input.keyboard: Focus inside the marquee pauses it when pauseOnFocus is true; duplicate items are inert so each item is tabbed once

a11y.notes: The duplicate copy is aria-hidden and inert so screen readers and keyboard users encounter each element once. A built-in pause/play button is shown unless showPauseButton is false or reduced motion is set.

props.name: children
props.effect: Required. Content elements repeated across the strip (rendered twice; avoid fixed ids).

props.name: pixelsPerSecond
props.effect: Transit rate in physical pixels per second (default 40). speed multiplies it. The cycle is never shorter than 5 s.

props.name: speed
props.effect: Unitless multiplier on pixelsPerSecond (1 = as given, 0.5 = half, 2 = double).

props.name: paused
props.effect: Universal pause prop. Freezes ticker transit.

props.name: nonce
props.effect: Optional CSP nonce forwarded to internal scoped <style> element.

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.effect: Freezes scroll transit while the pointer hovers over the strip.

props.name: pauseOnFocus
props.effect: Freezes scroll transit while any element inside the strip holds keyboard focus.

props.name: showPauseButton
props.effect: Renders a pause/play button (not rendered under reduced motion). Keep it for marquees that run longer than 5 s.

props.name: gap
props.effect: Spacing between items (a number is treated as px).

props.name: className
props.effect: CSS classes applied to the outer container (the built-in class fb-marquee is kept).

props.name: style
props.effect: Optional. No default. Inline styles on the outer container, merged last (consumer wins).

props.name: maxTier
props.effect: Hard ceiling on the capability tier.

mistakes: Do not remove the inert attribute from duplicate tracks or screen readers will double-read every item.
Do not hide the pause control if the marquee runs continuously for more than 5 seconds (WCAG 2.2.2).
The animation only runs when <html> has data-motion="ok" (MotionReadyScript in Next, initMotionReady() in Vite); without it the strip is static.
Children are rendered twice, so do not give them fixed id attributes. Other props (id, data-*, aria-*, handlers) are spread on the root <div>.
verify: Verify screen reader encounters each badge/item exactly once.
Verify hovering or focusing an item pauses animation transit.
Verify reduced motion stops the animation and renders a static row without a duplicate copy or pause button.
Confirm Pause then Play resumes the animation while the pointer or keyboard focus is still on the button.
